raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "be able to sell"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "the apartment from Brăila"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "agree"
  role subject "all heirs"
  role object "the sale"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "sign"
  role subject "all heirs"
  role object "a power of attorney"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a3 assumed
  relation "be finalized"
  role subject "the succession"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature
